pages.title: Our History
pages.text_en:
Siha District was officially established on 1 July 2007 under the Local Government Act No. 7 of 1982. It was formed by splitting from Hai District to enhance administrative efficiency and service delivery. The name “Siha” is derived from a prominent local river, Mto wa Siha, which flows from Mount Kilimanjaro and has historically supported agriculture and settlement in the area. Siha encompasses the Shira Plateau, one of the three volcanic cones of Mount Kilimanjaro. This gives the district a unique ecological and touristic value, contributing to its nickname “West Kili.” The district headquarters is located in Sanya Juu, a growing town that serves as the administrative and commercial hub.
Geographical Location
Siha District is located on the western slopes of Mount Kilimanjaro in northern Tanzania, within Kilimanjaro Region. It borders Meru district in Arusha Region to the west and Hai and Rombo Districts to the east and northeast. Siha lies along the Arusha–Moshi highway, making it a transit corridor between Kilimanjaro and Arusha Regions. The district lies between Latitude of 3°11′11″ South and Longitude: 37°04′07″ East.
pages.text_sw:
Wilaya ya Siha ilianzishwa rasmi tarehe 1 Julai 2007 kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Serikali za Mitaa Na. 7 ya mwaka 1982. Iliundwa baada ya kugawanywa kutoka Wilaya ya Hai kwa lengo la kuboresha ufanisi wa kiutawala na utoaji wa huduma kwa wananchi. Jina “Siha” limetokana na mto maarufu wa eneo hilo unaoitwa Mto wa Siha, unaotiririka kutoka Mlima Kilimanjaro na ambao kwa muda mrefu umechangia shughuli za kilimo na makazi ya watu.
Wilaya ya Siha inajumuisha eneo la Tambarare za Shira, mojawapo ya koni tatu za volkeno za Mlima Kilimanjaro. Hali hii huipa wilaya umuhimu wa kipekee kiikolojia na kitalii, jambo linalochangia kuitwa kwa jina la utani “West Kili.” Makao makuu ya wilaya yapo Sanya Juu, mji unaokua kwa kasi ambao ni kitovu cha shughuli za kiutawala na kibiashara.
Eneo la Kijiografia
Wilaya ya Siha ipo kwenye miteremko ya magharibi ya Mlima Kilimanjaro, kaskazini mwa Tanzania, ndani ya Mkoa wa Kilimanjaro. Inapakana na Wilaya ya Meru (Mkoa wa Arusha) upande wa magharibi, na Wilaya za Hai na Rombo upande wa mashariki na kaskazini-mashariki. Siha ipo kandokando ya barabara kuu ya Arusha–Moshi, hivyo kuwa njia muhimu ya mawasiliano kati ya Mikoa ya Kilimanjaro na Arusha. Kijiografia, wilaya ipo katika latitudo 3°11′11″ Kusini na longitudo 37°04′07″ Mashariki.

pages.title: Vission and Mission
pages.text_en:
Vision Statement of SIHA DC
The vision statement of Siha District Council is to be a council with high quality services, for sustainable development.
Mission Statement of SIHA DC
The mission statement defines Siha District Council core purpose, operational focus and approach to fulfilling its vision. The Mission of Siha District Council is “To promote sustainable development through effective resources utilization, community participation, gender equality, environmental management, accountability and transparency.
pages.text_sw:
Dira ya Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Siha (SIHA DC)
Dira ya Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Siha ni kuwa halmashauri inayotoa huduma bora zenye viwango vya juu kwa ajili ya kufanikisha maendeleo endelevu kwa jamii.
Dhima ya Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Siha (SIHA DC)
Dhima ya Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Siha inaeleza lengo kuu, mwelekeo wa utekelezaji na namna ya kufikia dira yake. Halmashauri inalenga kuhamasisha na kusimamia maendeleo endelevu kwa kutumia rasilimali zilizopo kwa ufanisi, kushirikisha wananchi katika maamuzi na utekelezaji, kuzingatia usawa wa kijinsia, kulinda na kutunza mazingira, pamoja na kuimarisha uwajibikaji na uwazi katika utoaji wa huduma.

pages.title: Core Values
pages.text_en:
Core Values of SIHA DC
The core values guide Siha DC organizational culture, employee behavior, and decision making, ensuring consistency, integrity and excellence in service delivery. Siha DC is guided by core values that defines its organizational culture and direct the conduct of all employees. These values reflect our commitment to excellence, Integrity, accountability, transparency, effectiveness and efficiency, continuous learning in delivering high quality services. They serve as the foundation for achieving Siha DC vision and mission while fostering accountability, transparency and continuous improvement across all operations.
Integrity By conducting duties with honest, ethical behavior and respect for the law, ensuring that public trust is upheld at all time.
Accountability Shall guide the way the district council will be discharging its responsibilities and therefore its accountability for the outcomes.
Transparency Shall guide the practice of openness in decision making and the provision of services by the council.
Effectiveness and efficiency Effectiveness by being output-oriented, striving to deliver high standards for work and aiming at choosing activities that delivery utility to customers and clients – doing the “right” things; Efficiency by consciously aiming at using resources in the most efficient way, saving to deliver services at minimum cost and time, and constantly improving the way it works – doing things “right”
Continuous Learning Is a conviction of Siha District Council taking cognizant that knowledge will never be complete and this can be realized through collaborative and continuous learning from other organization and councils.
pages.text_sw:
Maadili ya Msingi ya Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Siha (SIHA DC)
Maadili ya msingi ya Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Siha yanaongoza utamaduni wa taasisi, mwenendo wa watumishi na mchakato wa maamuzi, ili kuhakikisha uwiano, uadilifu na ubora katika utoaji wa huduma. Maadili haya yanaakisi dhamira ya halmashauri katika kufikia viwango vya juu vya utendaji, kwa kuzingatia uadilifu, uwajibikaji, uwazi, ufanisi na kujifunza endelevu. Ni msingi muhimu wa kutekeleza dira na dhima ya halmashauri, huku yakihamasisha uwajibikaji na maboresho ya mara kwa mara katika shughuli zote.
1. Uadilifu
Halmashauri inatekeleza majukumu yake kwa uaminifu, maadili mema na kwa kuheshimu sheria, ili kulinda na kudumisha imani ya wananchi wakati wote.
2. Uwajibikaji
Halmashauri inaongozwa na wajibu wa kuwajibika kikamilifu kwa matokeo ya maamuzi na utekelezaji wa majukumu yake, kwa manufaa ya jamii inayohudumiwa.
3. Uwazi
Halmashauri inahakikisha kuwepo kwa uwazi katika mchakato wa kufanya maamuzi na katika utoaji wa huduma, ili wananchi wapate taarifa sahihi na kwa wakati.
4. Ufanisi na Tija
Ufanisi : Halmashauri inalenga kufikia matokeo yaliyokusudiwa kwa kuzingatia viwango vya juu vya utendaji na kuchagua shughuli zenye manufaa kwa wateja na wananchi—yaani kufanya mambo sahihi.
Tija : Halmashauri hutumia rasilimali kwa umakini na kwa njia bora zaidi, ili kupunguza gharama na muda wa utoaji huduma, huku ikiendelea kuboresha utendaji wake—yaani kufanya mambo kwa usahihi.
5. Kujifunza Endelevu
Halmashauri inaamini kuwa maarifa hayana mwisho; hivyo inahimiza kujifunza kwa kushirikiana na taasisi na halmashauri nyingine ili kuboresha utendaji na kuongeza ubora wa huduma zinazotolewa.

pages.title: Human Resource Management and Administration Division
pages.text_en:
Introduction
The Division of Administration and Human Resources is responsible for ensuring that all public service laws, regulations, and procedures are followed . This helps maintain good governance and effective service delivery to the residents of Siha District.
Administratively, the Siha District Council is led by the Executive Director .
At the ward level , administrative responsibilities are managed by the Ward Executive Officer , who oversees peace, security, and administrative activities within the ward.
At the village level , the Village Executive Officer is responsible for maintaining peace, security, and all administrative operations within the village.
Services Provided by the Division
The Division of Administration and Human Resources performs several key functions, including:
Supervising all administrative activities within the council , such as ensuring that all statutory meetings from the village level to the district council are conducted on time and according to established rules and procedures.
Providing administrative advice to the Executive Director .
Ensuring that employees receive their rights and benefits , including:
Timely salary payments
Leave entitlements
Other employment benefits.
Interpreting policies, laws, regulations, and organizational structures related to public servants and coordinating their implementation.
Promoting good working relationships and cooperation among employees in the workplace .
Ensuring that employees who have reached the end of their service due to retirement or other reasons are removed from the payroll through the LAWSON system .
Handling disciplinary matters of employees in collaboration with heads of departments.
Ensuring that the council has adequate staff according to the approved staffing structure , while also coordinating staff training programs.
Supervising the confirmation of employment and promotion of employees within the required timeframes.
Managing and safeguarding council assets , including vehicles, offices, and equipment, and ensuring they are used properly.
Preparing the salary budget and wage estimates for employees of Siha District Council.
Ensuring employees work in a conducive working environment and are provided with necessary tools and equipment to deliver quality services to the public.
Coordinating employee performance evaluation using the Open Performance Review and Appraisal System (OPRAS).
Achievements
The division has achieved several milestones, including:
Improving employee performance and efficiency through both internal and external training programs .
Successfully increasing the number of staff members in accordance with government allocations and the council’s staffing requirements for each financial year.
pages.text_sw:
DIVISHENI YA UTAWALA NA RASILIMALI WATU
Utangulizi
Divisheni ya utawala na utumishi ina jukumu la kuhakikisha kuwa sheria, taratibu na kanuni zote za kiutumishi zinafuatwa ili kuweza kudumisha utawala bora na utoaji huduma nzuri kwa jamii ya Siha.
Kiutawala halmashauri ya siha inaongozwa na Mkurugenzi Mtendaji. Katika ngazi ya kata anayesimamia majukumu yote ya kata ni Afisa mtendaji kata hivyo ana jukumu la kusimamia ulinzi, amani na usalama katika kata pamoja na shughuli zote za kiutawala ndani ya kata. Katika ngazi ya vijiji, mwenye jukumu la kusimamia amani na ulinzi katika kijiji ni Mtendaji wa kijiji pamoja na shughuli zote za kiutawala ndani ya kijiji.
Huduma zinazotolewa na Divisheni
Ø Kazi kubwa katika idara ya utawala na utumishi ni kusimamia shughuli zote za kiutawala ndani ya Halmashauri mfano kuhakikisha vikao vyote vya kisheria kuanzia ngazi ya kijiji mpaka halmashauri vinafanyika kwa wakati kwa kufuata kanuni na taratibu za vikao.
Ø Kutoa ushauri kwa Mkurugenzi Mtendaji kuhusu maswala ya kiutawala
Ø Kuhakikisha haki na stahiki zote za watumishi zinapatikana mfano watumishi wanapata mishahara yao kwa wakati, likizo kwa watumishi na haki zote za mtumishi mahalapa kazi.
Ø Kutafsiri sera, sheria na kanuni pamoja na miundo zinazohusu watumishi na kuratibu utekelezaji wake.
Kuhakisha kuna mahusiano mazuri pamoja na ushirikiano kati ya mtumishi na mtumishi mahala pakazi.
Kuhakikisha watumishi wote ambao muda wao umefikia ukomo kwa sababu mbali mbali wanaondolewa katika payroll kupitia mfumo wa LAWSON.
Kusimamia masuala ya nidhamu kwa watumishi wote kwa kushirikiana na Wakuu wa Idara.
Ø Kuhakikisha halmashauri inakuwa na watumishi wa kutosha kulingana na ikama ya kila idara, pia inasimamia mpango mzima wa mafunzo kwa watumishi wa Halmashauri.
Ø Kusimamia swala zima la watumishi kuwa wanathibitishwa na kupandishwa vyeo kwa wakati.
Ø Kusimamia mali za halmashauri na kuhakikisha zinatumika vizuri mfano magari, ofisi na mitambo.
Ø Kuandaa bajeti na makisio ya mishahara kwa watumishi wa wilaya Siha
Ø Pia kuhakikisha watumishi wanafanya kazi katika mazingira mazuri ya kazi na kuwapatia vitendea kazi vinavyohitajika na vitumike vizuri pamoja na kuhifadhiwa vizuri ili kudumisha huduma nzuri kwa wateja .
Ø Kuratibu shughuli za upimaji wa utendaji kazi wa watumishi wa halmashauri kwa kutumia mfumo wa wazi na kupitia na kupima utendaji wa watumishi (OPRAS).
Mafanikio
Ø Idara imefanya juhudi za kuhakisha watumishi wanaongeza ufanisi katika utendaji kazi kwa kuwapatia mafunzo ya ndani na ya nje ya ofisi
Ø Halmashauri imefanikiwa kuongeza watumishi kwa kadri serikali ilivyotupangia pia kulingana na mahitaji ya watumishi kwa mwaka husika.

pages.title: Agriculture
pages.text_en:
Introduction
The Siha District Council has a total of 53,268 hectares of land suitable for agriculture , of which 37,839 hectares are currently under cultivation . The main food crops grown in the district are maize and beans , while the major cash crops are coffee and barley . Other crops cultivated in the district include bananas, potatoes, fruits (especially avocados), vegetables (such as carrots, green peppers, tomatoes, peas, and other varieties), pigeon peas, and sunflower .
Department of Agriculture, Irrigation and Cooperatives
The Division of Agriculture, Irrigation and Cooperatives is one of the thirteen (13) division within the Siha District Council. Its primary responsibility is to provide professional agricultural advisory services to citizens in order to improve agricultural productivity and efficiency. This support aims to ensure food security and increase household income for the community.
The department is organized into three main sections , namely:
Crop Production (Agriculture)
Irrigation
Cooperatives
Division Objective
The main objective of the department is to ensure adequate food availability and improve household income levels within the district.
Strategies for Achieving the Objective
To achieve its objective, the department implements several strategies, including:
Coordinating and supervising the implementation of community-initiated development projects aimed at addressing challenges faced by farmers.
Improving irrigation infrastructure through the construction and rehabilitation of irrigation canals and dams to enhance water availability for farming. Examples of improved or rehabilitated projects include the Mitimirefu, Namwai, Wandri, Mese, Kasaisa, and Lawate main irrigation canals , as well as the construction of the Kishisha irrigation dam and canal and the Mowonjamu irrigation dam .
Enhancing coffee production by establishing a large nursery capable of producing over 1,000,000 improved coffee seedlings annually .
Providing training on improved agricultural practices for both food and cash crops through farmer field schools, demonstration plots, farmer field days, participation in Nanenane agricultural exhibitions , and educational study tours.
Promoting agribusiness knowledge among farmer groups , including value addition to agricultural products and linking farmers to markets.
Coordinating and supervising the distribution of government-subsidized agricultural inputs to beneficiary farmers. These inputs include improved maize seeds, basal fertilizer, and top-dressing fertilizer .
Educating farmers on reducing post-harvest losses .
Collecting and maintaining important agricultural production statistics .
Providing training on sustainable land management practices .
Inspecting and supervising cooperative societies , including Agricultural Marketing Cooperative Societies (AMCOS) and Savings and Credit Cooperative Societies (SACCOS) .
Collaborating with research institutions to introduce and distribute new agricultural technologies to farmers.
Working with non-governmental organizations (NGOs) to promote and disseminate improved agricultural technologies.
Challenges Facing the Division
The department faces several challenges, including:
Insufficient financial resources to implement all development projects proposed by farmers.
Lack of adequate working tools and equipment for extension officers at the village, ward, and district levels. These include transportation for field visits and soil testing kits for assessing soil health.
Shortage of agricultural extension officers and cooperative officers .
Proposed Solutions
To address these challenges, the following measures are proposed:
Advising the central government to increase the budget ceiling for the agricultural sector to support development projects and procurement of working tools for experts.
Encouraging private organizations and stakeholders to allocate funds for implementing community-driven development projects.
Allocating a portion of internally generated revenue by the council to support farmer-initiated development projects.
Developing a human resource plan to address the shortage of professionals in different agricultural and cooperative fields.

DIVISHENI YA KILIMO, UMWAGILIAJI NA USHIRIKA
Utangulizi
Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Siha ina ukubwa wa eneo la Hekta 53,268 zinazofaa kwa Kilimo ambapo hadi sasa eneo linalolimwa ni Hekta 37,839. Mazao makuu ya chakula yanayolimwa ni Mahindi na Maharage na Mazao makuu ya biashara ni Kahawa na Shayiri. Mazao mengine yanayolimwa ni pamoja na Ndizi,Viazi Mviringo, Matunda (Parachichi), Mboga (Karoti, Hoho, Nyanya, Njegere na aina nyingine za mboga), Mbaazi na Alizeti.
Divisheni ya Kilimo Umwagiliaji na Ushirika
Divisheni ya Kilimo, Umwagiliaji na Ushirika ni miongoni mwa Idara kumi na tatu (13) za Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Siha ambayo wajibu wake ni kutoa ushauri wa kitaalam kwa Wananchi katika kuboresha uzalishaji na tija kwa mazao ya Kilimo ili kujitosheleza kwa chakula na kuongeza kipato kwa Kaya.
Idara imegawanyika katika sehemu tatu ambazo ni sehemu ya Uzalishaji mazao (Kilimo), Umwagiliaji na Ushirika.
Lengo la Divisheni
Upatikanaji wa chakula cha kutosha na ongezeko la kipato kwa kaya
Mikakati ya kufikia lengo
Kuratibu na kusimamia utekelezaji wa Miradi ya maendeleo iliyoibuliwa na wananchi ili kutatua changamoto wanazokabiliana nazo.
Miradi hiyo ni pamoja na Ujenzi na ukarabati wa miundombinu ya umwagiliaji ili kuboresha upatikanaji wa maji ya umwagiliaji. Miradi iliyoboreshwa/kukarabatiwa ni Mfereji mkuu wa Umwagiliaji Mitimirefu, Mfereji mkuu wa umwagiliaji Namwai, Mfereji mkuu wa Umwagiliaji Wandri, Mfereji mkuu wa Umwagiliaji Mese, Mfereji mkuu wa Umwagiliaji Kasaisa, Mfereji mkuu wa Umwagiliaji Lawate, Ujenzi wa Bwawa na mfereji mkuu wa umwagiliaji Kishisha na Ujenzi wa Bwawa la Umwagiliaji Mowonjamu
Kuboresha uzalishaji zao la Kahawa kwa kuanzisha bustani kubwa itakayoweza kuzalisha zaidi ya miche bora 1,000,000 kwa mwaka
Kutoa mafunzo ya Kilimo bora cha mazao ya chakula na biashara kwa wakulima kupitia mashamba darasa, mashamba ya mfano, Kuandaa siku ya wakulima, kushiriki maonesho ya Nanenane na ziara za mafunzo
Kutoa elimu ya Kilimo biashara kwa vikundi vya wakulima (kuongeza thamani mazao ya Kilimo na kuwaunganisha wakulima na masoko)
Kuratibu na kusimamia usambazaji wa Pembejeo za Kilimo zenye ruzuku ya Serikali kwa wakulima wanufaika. Pembejeo zinazosambazwa ni pamoja na Mbegu bora za Mahindi, Mbolea ya kupandia na mbolea ya kukuzia
Kutoa elimu kwa wakulima juu ya kupunguza upotevu wa mazao baada ya kuvuna (Post harvest losses)
Kukusanya na kutunza Takwimu muhimu za uzalishaji wa mazao ya Kilimo
Kutoa elimu ya matumizi bora ya Ardhi (Sustainable Land Management)
Kukagua na kusimamia vyama vya Ushirika vya Mazao (AMCOS), Akiba na Mikopo (SACCOS)
Kushirikiana na vituo vya Utafiti kusambaza teknolojia mpya za Kilimo kwa wakulima
Kushirikiana na taasisi zisizokuwa za kiserikali (NGOs) katika usambazaji wa teknolojia mpya za Kilimo
Changamoto zinazoikabili Divisheni
Upungufu wa rasilimali fedha za kutosha kutekeleza miradi yote ya maendeleo inayoibuliwa na wakulima
Upungufu wa vitendea kazi kwa wataalam, Ngazi ya Kijiji, Kata na Wilaya. Vitendea kazi hivyo ni pamoja na usafiri ili kuwafikia wakulima kwa urahisi na vifaa vya kupima afya ya udongo (Soil Test Kits)
Upungufu wa Maafisa ugani na maafisa Ushirika
Utatuzi wa Changamoto
Kushauri Serikali kuu kuongeza ukomo wa bajeti (Budget Ceiling) ya Sekta ya Kilimo ili kusaidia utekelezaji wa miradi na ununuzi wa vitendea kazi kwa wataalam
Kuhamasisha asasi binafsi kutenga fedha kwa ajili utekelezaji wa miradi inayoibuliwa na jamii
Halmashauri kutenga sehemu ya fedha za mapato ya ndani kusaidia utekelezaji wa miradi inayoibuliwa na wakulima
Kuweka mpango wa mahitaji ya wataalam wa Kada mbalimbali

pages.title: Community
pages.text_en:
INTRODUCTION
The Division of Community Development and Social Welfare is one of the thirteen departments responsible for implementing and achieving the objectives of the Siha District Council in accordance with government guidelines, policies, and established strategies. The department implements both short-term and long-term plans aimed at improving and advancing the livelihoods of the people of Siha District.
The department consists of several units including:
Planning and Research
Gender and Children
HIV/AIDS
TASAF (Tanzania Social Action Fund)
Community Economic Empowerment
The department employs Community Development and Social Welfare professionals at both district and ward levels. These staff members are responsible for implementing, supervising, monitoring, and evaluating the department’s goals in line with the Millennium Development Goals (MDGs), MKUKUTA (National Strategy for Growth and Reduction of Poverty), and the National Development Vision 2025.
Core Values of the Division
The department operates under the following core values:
Commitment and dedication
Integrity and accountability
Teamwork
Justice and fairness
Transparency
Respect
Efficiency
Participatory management
Continuous learning
Guided by these principles, the department mobilizes, educates, and empowers communities to develop a strong motivation for socio-economic development. It helps communities identify their own problems and utilize available resources to improve their income and living standards. The department works in collaboration with the government, organizations, and various institutions to support community-driven development initiatives.
Indicators Used to Measure Community Development
The department evaluates community development in Siha District using the following indicators:
Changes in attitudes, cultural practices, and traditions within the community
Improvement and expansion of social services such as housing, healthcare, education, nutrition, and clean and safe environments
Increased household income enabling families to meet their needs and save resources
Reduction in maternal and child mortality rates
Adoption of modern technologies
Proper use and conservation of the environment
Based on these indicators, the department aims to gradually reduce and ultimately eradicate poverty in Siha District and Tanzania as a whole.
DEPARTMENTAL OBJECTIVES
1. Strengthening Children’s Rights in 60 Villages by 2025
Strategies
Identify vulnerable children in 60 villages and establish committees responsible for addressing their needs.
Provide psychosocial support to vulnerable children (Most Vulnerable Children – MVC) and relevant village committees.
Provide school uniforms for vulnerable primary and secondary school students.
Educate communities on the negative impacts of harmful cultural practices such as female genital mutilation, child abuse, and early marriages.
Establish children’s councils at ward and district levels.
2. Establishment and Strengthening of Social and Economic Groups by 2025
Strategies
Mobilize communities to form and register socio-economic groups in 60 villages to improve income and reduce poverty.
Provide entrepreneurship training to these groups.
Facilitate and provide loans to social and economic groups.
3. Reduction of HIV/AIDS Infections from 2.5% to 2.0% by 2025
Strategies
Encourage voluntary HIV testing among community members.
Encourage people living with HIV/AIDS to openly declare their status and form support networks.
Provide HIV/AIDS education to village and ward committees responsible for HIV prevention.
Commemorate World AIDS Day annually.
4. Strengthening Gender Issues in 17 Wards by 2025
Strategies
Encourage women to contest leadership positions.
Increase community awareness of gender issues.
Celebrate International Women’s Day annually.
5. Strengthening Non-Governmental Organizations by 2025
Strategies
Identify NGOs operating within the district and their areas of operation.
Establish networks among NGOs.
Conduct performance evaluations and meetings for NGOs within the district.
6. Community Mobilization to Form Community-Based Organizations (CBOs)
Communities in 60 villages are encouraged to establish CBOs to engage in small-scale income-generating activities.
7. Strengthening the Division of Community Development and Social Welfare by 2025
Strategies
Recruit additional staff at ward and district levels.
Enable staff to attend short-term and long-term professional training.
Ensure availability of adequate working equipment and tools.
8. Enhancing Participation of People with Disabilities in 60 Villages by 2025
Strategies
Identify persons with disabilities and assess their needs.
Establish and register disability networks.
Provide entrepreneurship training for people with disabilities.
9. Promoting Appropriate and Simple Technology in 60 Villages by 2025
Strategies
Educate communities on the use of simple and appropriate technologies.
Encourage environmental conservation.
Build community capacity through awareness on appropriate technology use.
10. Strengthening the Rights of the Elderly by 2025
Strategies
Identify elderly persons aged 60 years and above in 60 villages.
Encourage the elderly to establish and register entrepreneurship groups.
Involve the elderly in decision-making meetings at village, ward, and district levels.
Facilitate access to health insurance cards for the elderly.
11. Improving Awareness of Good Governance Among Leaders
Strategy
Educate ward councils and village governments about the concept and importance of good governance for sustainable community development.
12. Reducing Household Poverty by 2025
Strategies
Identify poor households in 60 villages.
Establish committees to coordinate and supervise support for poor households.
Provide financial resources to strengthen their economic and social capacity.
Offer leadership training on good governance.
Empower communities to work hard with knowledge and discipline to generate income and improve their living standards using available resources.
ACHIEVEMENTS
Since the establishment of Siha District in 2005, the Community Development Division has achieved significant progress. The department has been at the forefront of facilitating the implementation of various government policies, programs, strategies, and campaigns through participatory community development approaches. Communities are actively involved in decision-making processes such as planning, implementing, monitoring, and evaluating development initiatives affecting their economic, social, political, and administrative welfare.
Key achievements include:
Identification and support of 4,144 vulnerable children who have received various social and economic services.
Establishment of village committees responsible for supporting vulnerable children.
Increased access to education for both boys and girls.
Reduction in female genital mutilation and early marriages.
Increased participation of children in decision-making processes affecting them.
Formation and registration of 730 socio-economic groups .
110 groups have received loans and entrepreneurship training.
The Community Development sector has strengthened other sectors within the council by motivating citizens to improve economic activities, reduce poverty, and promote good governance.
CHALLENGES FACED BY THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
1. Strengthening the Construction Unit
The unit plays a significant role in supporting citizens to build better houses and social infrastructure, particularly in rural areas. There is a need to strengthen the unit with adequate technical resources and equipment.
2. Improving Motivation of Community Development Professionals
Due to continuous social and global changes, these professionals require improved professional training, working environments, incentives, and resources to effectively address emerging community needs.
3. Utilization of Community Development Centers
Community centers should be constructed to support various social activities such as meetings, training for women on nutrition, home management, tailoring, sports, entertainment, and educational activities.
4. Recognition of Community Contributions to Development
Citizens contribute significantly to development projects such as the construction of schools, dispensaries, roads, water wells, and other infrastructure. However, these contributions are often not reflected in government budgets and accounts, making it difficult to accurately measure the country’s economic output. There is a need to include community contributions in government budgeting.
5. Shortage of Community Development Experts
Community development officers play a crucial role in mobilizing and empowering citizens to participate in their own development. Ideally, there should be at least one professional in every ward.
6. Insufficient Working Tools and Equipment
Community development work requires sufficient tools and equipment, including transportation, to effectively reach and support communities.
7. Need for Positive Behavioral Change
Communities must adopt positive attitudes and behaviors to address emerging economic, political, and social challenges. The department continuously educates and mobilizes communities on the benefits and impacts of various societal issues.
8. Strengthening the Fight Against Ignorance, Disease, and Poverty
Ignorance, disease, and poverty remain major obstacles to development in Tanzania. Despite government efforts, many citizens still face income poverty and disease outbreaks. Community development professionals play a critical role in educating communities about environmental hygiene, disease prevention, and effective economic project planning to combat poverty.
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS IMPLEMENTED THROUGH PARTICIPATORY APPROACHES
Several community-based projects have been implemented to promote self-reliance, including:
Construction of classrooms in several secondary and primary schools funded through TASAF.
Goat farming projects for elderly groups.
Poultry farming projects for people living with HIV/AIDS.
Dairy goat projects for orphaned children.
These projects have reached different stages of completion, with some completed fully and others in progress, depending on funding availability and implementation conditions.
For example:
A dairy goat project for elderly people in Samaki Maini Village distributed 41 goats to 39 elderly beneficiaries and was completed successfully.
A poultry project in Lawate Village distributed 200 chickens to 10 beneficiaries living with HIV/AIDS , and it was completed successfully.
Several classroom construction projects in secondary and primary schools have reached completion levels ranging from 25% to 95% depending on the stage of construction.
Despite some projects not fully completed due to funding delays or logistical challenges, many facilities are already being used due to shortages of classrooms and other community infrastructure.

Divisheni ya Maendeleo ya Jamii na Ustawi wa Jamii ni kati ya Idara 13 ambazo zinatekeleza na kutimiza malengo ya Halmashauri ya wilaya ya Siha kwa kuzingatia miongozo ya serikali, Sera na mikakati iliyowekwa.Idara ina mipango ya muda mfupi na muda mrefu ambayo inalenga kuendeleza nakuboresha maisha ya watu katika wilaya ya Siha. Idara ina vitengo ambavyo ni:-
Mipango na Utafiti, Jinsia na Watoto, UKIMWI, TASAF na Uwezeshaji wananchiki-uchumi. Idara ina watumishi wa fani ya Maendeleo ya Jamii na Ustawi wa Jamii ngazi ya wilaya na Kata ambao wanatekeleza, kusimamia, kufuatilia na kutathimini utekelezaji wa malengo hayo kwa kuzingatia malengo ya Milenia, MKUKUTA na Dira ya Mendeleo ya Taifa ya mwaka 2025.

Ukeketaji na ndoa za utotoni zimepungua

CHANGAMOTO ZA UTENDAJI KAZI IDARA YA MAENDELEO YA JAMII:-
Uimarishaji wa kikosi cha Ujenzi:
Kikosi hiki kina mchango mkubwa kwa wananchi katika jitihada zao za kujijengea nyumba bora na miundombinu nyingine ya Kijamii hususani maeneo ya kijijini. Ipo haja ya kuanzisha na kuimarisha kwa nyenzo na rasilimali za kiufundi ili kukidhi matarajio ya wananchi.
Uimarishaji wa Ari ya utendaji kazi wa wataalamu wa maendeleo ya Jamii.
Kutokana na mabadiliko yanayotokea miongoni mwa jamii na duniani kote, wataalam hawa wanahitaji kuimarishwa kitaaluma, kimazingira,kimaslahi,kinyenzo nk ili waweze kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mahitaji katika jamii.
Matumizi ya majumba ya maendeleo :
Kujenga majumba ya maendeleo kwa madhumuni mbalimbali ya kijamii yakiwemo mikutano ya kijamii ya kupashana habari za kijamii,mafunzo kwa wanawake kuhusu lishe,utunzaji wa nyumba,ususi,michezo,burudani,kisomo chenye manufaa na kujiendeleza.
Uthaminishaji wa mchango wa Jamii katika shughuli za maendeleo:-
Wananchi wamekuwa wakichangia nguvu zao katika utekelezaji wa miradi mbalimbali ya maendeleo kama ujenzi wa shule, Zahanati, barabara, visima vya maji na miudombinu nyingine wakisaidiana na juhudi za serikali. Michango hii haionekani waziwazi katika bajeti na hesabu za serikali hivyo kutokuwa na picha sahihi ya pato la taifa ambalo ndilo kigezo kikuu cha kiwango cha maendeleo ya nchi. Ipo haja ya kuthaminisha mchangowa wananchi katika bajeti za serikali ili kuweza kupata picha ya maendeleo ya nchi yetu.
Upatikanaji wa wataalamu wa Maendeleo ya Jamii wa kutosha:-
Wataalamu wa Maendeleo ya Jamii ndiyo waandaaji wa watu kwa ajili ya kuwawezesha kushiriki Maendeleo yao. Ili waweze kutimiza azma hiyo kunahitajika walao mtaalamu mmoja kila kata.
Upatikanaji wa nyenzo na Vitendea kazi vya kutosha:-
_ Msingi wa maendeleo ya Jamii unalenga katika kuwezesha watu, kujihudumia katika kujiletea maendeleo endelevu. Ili kutekeleza azma hii wataalamu wa maendeleo ya Jamii wanahitaji kuwezeshwa kinyenzo na vitendea kazi ikiwa ni pamoja na vyombo vya usafiri.
Kuwepo kwa mabadiliko chanya ya Tabia za watu:-
Jamii inahitaji kuwa na mabadiliko chanya ya kitabia ili kukabiliana na matukio na matatizo yanayojitokeza katika Jamii, kiuchumi, kisiasa na kiutawala. Idara ya maendeleo ya Jamii inaelimisha, inaraghbisha, inahamasisha na kushawishi Jamii kuhusu, manufaa na athari za matukio mbalimbali yanayoonekana katika maisha ya kawaida ya Jamii.
Uimarishaji wa vita dhidi ya Ujinga, Maradhi na Umaskini:-
Ujinga, Maradhi na Umaskini vinaendelea kuwa maadui wa Maendeleo ya wananchi wa Tanzania tangu tupate Uhuru. Pamoja na serikali kutilia mkazo vita dhidi ya maadui hao, hali ya maisha ya wananchi walio wengi imeendelea kukabiliwa na umaskini wa kipato na magonjwa ya mlipuko. Wataalamu wa maendeleo ya Jamii wanapaswa kuimarisha utoaji wa elimu kwa Jamii kuhusu usafi wa mazingira na kinga dhidi ya maradhi,mbinu bora za kuandaa miradi ya kiuchumi kupambana na umaskini wa kipato.

Introduction
The Planning, Statistics and Monitoring Division consists of two main sections:
Policy and Planning Section
Statistics and Monitoring Section
The department is headed and supervised by the District Planning Officer , who serves as the Head of the Department.
Main Objectives of the Division
